integrations.name: YouTube Shorts
integrations.instructions: Obtain a free OAuth 2.0 Client ID or YouTube Data API v3 key from Google Cloud Console. No credit card required.
integrations.freeTierNotes: Free 10,000 quota units/day is sufficient to publish ~6-10 Shorts per day with zero fees.

integrations.name: TikTok for Developers
integrations.instructions: Create a free TikTok Developer app to schedule Direct Post videos, or use ClipGenius 1-click MP4 export.
integrations.freeTierNotes: TikTok Developer API is free to register. Video Kit Direct Post API requires business account verification.

integrations.name: Instagram Reels
integrations.dailyLimit: 25 API posts/day (Meta Graph API Free Tier)
integrations.instructions: Link an Instagram Professional / Creator account to a Facebook page, then configure Meta Graph API credentials.
integrations.freeTierNotes: Meta Graph API has no subscription fee for standard organic publishing limits.

integrations.name: LinkedIn Video
integrations.instructions: Configure LinkedIn Developer App with Member Data Portability / Share on LinkedIn permissions.
integrations.freeTierNotes: Free LinkedIn Developer portal access with standard organic sharing scopes.

integrations.name: Google Drive Storage
integrations.instructions: Save rendered 9:16 vertical clips and raw videos directly into a Google Drive folder. Paste your Google Drive Folder link or ID to auto-sync.
integrations.freeTierNotes: 15 GB free storage with any standard Google account. Never lose your clips and share them with your team in seconds.
